name: Input
description: YAMI Input Field from Figma `↪ 表单输入 Forms`. Native input with embedded label by default (56px on PC and Mobile) and code-defined compact density with external label (40px on PC and Mobile), clear action, helper/error text, and accessible form semantics.

action.type: { label: string; onClick?: MouseEventHandler<HTMLButtonElement>; htmlType?: 'button' | 'submit'; disabled?: boolean }
action.description: Opt-in underlined text action inside the shared field border. Uses 14px value and action text, inherits disabled, and replaces trailingIcon/suffix and clear. Consumer owns submission and validation.

density.description: Default uses an embedded label at 56px. Compact uses an external label and one value row at 40px. PC and Mobile use the same heights.

label.description: Field label rendered inside the default control or above the compact control.

helperText.description: Supporting text below the input. Hidden when error is present.

error.description: Error supporting text. Sets aria-invalid, role='alert', and attention border.

state.description: Visual state override for catalog demos. Product usage normally derives state from value/focus/error/disabled.

clearable.description: Shows the clear-fill action while focus remains inside an editable field with a value, including error states. Hidden when read-only or disabled.

onValueChange.description: Base UI value callback alongside native onChange.

onClear.description: Called after the clear action sets the native value to empty and dispatches a bubbling input event.

leadingIcon.description: Icon/text rendered before the text stack. Use currentColor SVG assets from packages/design-system/assets/icons.

trailingIcon.description: Icon/text/action rendered after the text stack. Use currentColor SVG assets from packages/design-system/assets/icons and keep interactive actions controlled by component state.

required.description: Sets native required and renders an aria-hidden visual marker.

focus.note: Focused/typing states use a 2px --border-focus border. Tab/Shift+Tab adds a separate --focus-ring outline; pointer clicks suppress it, including external-label clicks and pointer clearing. Keyboard clearing preserves the ring on return focus. Focus-within keeps the clear action mounted.

disabled.note: Disabled uses --fill-tertiary, --text-secondary and a not-allowed cursor independently of error state; error borders/messages and aria-invalid remain available. Never opacity.

border.note: Default is --border-default, focus is --border-focus, error is --border-attention.

tapTarget.note: PC and Mobile are 56px by default or 40px compact. By explicit product request, clear uses a 24×24px hit target and a 20px icon in both densities, without an invisible extension. This is a code-defined exception to the general touch-target guidance.

assetSource.note: Clear and error icons are currentColor SVG paths from packages/design-system/assets/icons/action.

nativeSync.note: Uncontrolled visual state resyncs from native input/change and resets of the current form owner, including reassociation and later form mounting. Canceled resets preserve the current value.

accessibility.labelling: Visible embedded label is <label htmlFor={id}>. If no visible label is provided, consumer must pass aria-label.
accessibility.errorAnnouncement: error renders role='alert' and is linked via aria-describedby
accessibility.required: required=true uses native required and an aria-hidden visual marker
accessibility.disabled: native disabled prevents focus and editing
